docs.title: Cloud & DevOps Engineering Handbook
docs.text: Welcome to my personal technical knowledge base and architectural reference guide. Maintained by Joshy Joseph — Senior DevOps & Platform Engineer.

docs.title: What's Inside
docs.text:
• AWS Cloud: Account governance, IAM, VPC networking, EKS, and FinOps.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform state management, reusable modules, and Ansible automation.
  • Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes architecture, Helm charts, and production troubleshooting.
  • CI/CD & AI Automation: GitHub Actions, Jenkins pipelines, and AI-driven IaC workflows (MCP, Claude Code, AWS KIRO).
